name: Oath of Moment
text: Pick one enemy unit at the start of your Command phase; until your next Command phase, attacks by models with this ability against it may re-roll the hit roll.

name: Fury of the First
text: Attacks by this unit against the Oath target get +1 to hit.

name: Unstoppable Valour
text: Charge rolls made for this model's unit may be re-rolled.
